title: BankUnited, Inc. Announces Quarterly Dividend
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about BankUnited, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
MIAMI LAKES, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 24, 2026-- BankUnited, Inc. (NYSE:BKU) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.33 per common share. The dividend will be payable on October 30, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on October 09, 2026.


**About BankUnited, Inc.**


BankUnited, Inc. (NYSE: BKU), with total assets of $34.9 billion at June 30, 2026, is the bank holding company of BankUnited, N.A., a national bank headquartered in Miami Lakes, Florida, with operations in Florida, New York, Dallas, Atlanta, Morristown, New Jersey, and Charlotte, North Carolina. BankUnited provides a full range of consumer and commercial banking products and services to individuals, small businesses, middle-market companies, large corporations and institutions, and offers certain commercial lending and deposit products through national platforms.
